purpose: Three progression timeline visual prototypes, not runtime UI
prompts: Create one polished game UI concept sprite for the German mining roguelite Tiefenhall. Use the attached screenshot ONLY as the visual style reference: hand-painted rich dark walnut wood, aged brass riveted corner fittings, cream serif type, warmly lit golden accents; exotic blueprint rewards use deep navy paper, cyan crystal badge and fine turquoise diagram lines. This is a NEW progression timeline design, not the existing recipe selection screen. Isolated complete panel with true transparent surroundings, no scenery, no checkerboard, no explanatory prose, no watermark. Crisp readable German labels, beautiful carefully aligned professional game UI. Illustrative player current level is 12. Powerup points occur every level, exotic blueprints unlock the find pool at level5 Eisenleiter, level15 Lavalampe, level35 Spitzhammer. Blueprint art: riveted iron ladder, brass lantern with glowing orange lava, short wooden-handled steel pick-hammer. Blueprint reward captions must say Bauplan so these are not confused with awarded crafted items. Clear achieved/current/future states. VARIANT 1: a wide landscape horizontal reward rail in a single low wooden panel. Heading Fortschritt, small top-left Level 12. Along the bottom runs a brass rail with gold filled section to the current pointer, muted unfilled section beyond it. Main nodes in order Level 5 with a subdued completed iron ladder blueprint and gold check, Level 12 with a bright gold current-level diamond, Level 13 a gold medallion +1 Powerup-Punkt, Level 14 another small gold point medallion, Level 15 prominent cyan-framed lava lamp blueprint labeled Lavalampe and Bauplan. At far right after a clearly drawn dotted gap a smaller dimmed Level 35 Spitzhammer blueprint. Treat node spacing as discrete milestones not proportional numbers. The next powerup at13 is evident, lava lamp is upcoming major reward. Restrained framing, ample breathing room, all icons and labels entirely inside the panel.
